searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12303 seems a side effect from moving 7702 charges out of intrinsic gas. Now there's a pre-frame runtime window that didn't exist before, that unfortunately, behaves differently from the frame's runtime. Maybe the circular dependency of EIPs wasn't so great idea. well if we have left 7702 alone in intrinsic costs this wouldn't be an issue if I understand correctly. I'm not sure if I don't prefer that than creating yet another counter I copied the solution from execution-specs. Personally I don't care. Seems nobody is reading the EIP any more and whatever is there doesn't matter.
